content: Macrogol, also known as polyethylene glycol (PEG), is the International Nonproprietary Name (INN) for this compound. It is widely utilized in medical and pharmaceutical applications. One of its primary uses is as a laxative to manage and treat constipation. Additionally, macrogols serve as excipients in various pharmaceutical formulations. Lower molecular weight macrogols are employed as solvents in oral liquid preparations and soft capsules, while higher molecular weight variants are used in solid forms, such as ointment bases, tablet binders, film coatings, and lubricants.
